calendar.title: Season calendar
calendar.lead: Tasks with target dates and short guides – adapt to weather, forage and your method.

jan-ruhe.title: Do not disturb winter cluster rest
jan-ruhe.guide: Keep the hive closed in January. Observe only from outside (entrance, front). No vibrations at the apiary. Clear snow from the entrance.

jan-flugloch.title: Check entrance for blockage
jan-flugloch.guide: Dead bees and ice can block the entrance. Clear from outside on a frost-free day – hive stays closed. Check mouse guard fit.

jan-material.title: Repair / order gear for the new season
jan-material.guide: Straighten frames, check lids and floors, inventory queen excluders and varroa products. Order what’s missing before the season starts.

feb-reinigung.title: Watch cleansing flights
feb-reinigung.guide: On warm days assess flight from outside. Note crawlers and faecal spots. Keep the hive closed below ~12–14 °C.

feb-futter.title: Check stores by hefting the hive
feb-futter.guide: Heft lightly and compare with neighbours. Mark very light colonies. Emergency feeding only in mild weather with a brief opening.

feb-totbienen.title: Remove dead bees at the entrance
feb-totbienen.guide: Clear dead bees from the entrance. Large piles or foul smell need closer watching. Leave the mouse guard on.

mar-durchsicht.title: First spring inspection
mar-durchsicht.guide: Open briefly only in warm weather. Check brood, stores and queenrightness. Ideally under 10 minutes – stop if it turns cold.

mar-maeuse.title: Remove mouse guards
mar-maeuse.guide: After night frosts end and pollen flies, remove the guard. Adjust entrance width. Better wait a week than remove too early.

mar-boden.title: Clean the floor
mar-boden.guide: Pull and clean the insert/floor tray. Assess debris and mite drop. Refit dry and close the hive.

apr-honigraum.title: Cherry blossom: add supers
apr-honigraum.guide: Expand supers when the flow starts. Use a queen excluder if your method uses one. Late expansion often triggers swarming.

apr-drohnen.title: Hang drone frames (varroa prevention)
apr-drohnen.guide: Hang a drone frame at the brood nest edge. After capping, cut out or dispose and repeat the cycle.

apr-schwarm.title: Start swarm checks
apr-schwarm.guide: Pull brood frames and check lower edges for queen cells. Interval 7–9 days. If cells appear, make a nuc or planned action.

mai-schwarm.title: Weekly swarm checks
mai-schwarm.guide: May is peak season: open, hunt queen cells, check space and forage. Schedule the next check immediately.

mai-ableger.title: Make first nucleus colonies
mai-ableger.guide: Move 2–3 brood frames with bees (no old queen) plus stores into a nuc. Keep tight, protect from robbing. Donor colony must stay strong.

mai-honigraum.title: Check and expand supers
mai-honigraum.approxDate: May · every few days by flow
mai-honigraum.guide: Check fill and capping. Expand in time. Avoid empty volume if the flow stops.

jun-schwarm-ende.title: Final swarm checks
jun-schwarm-ende.guide: Keep intervals until play cups largely stop. Then focus on harvest and health.

jun-ernte.title: First honey harvest (spring flow)
jun-ernte.guide: Harvest only ripe honey (capped / shake test). Extract and log yield in Hively. Follow food hygiene.

jun-trachtluecke.title: Watch the nectar gap
jun-trachtluecke.guide: Check stores. Feed in the evening if needed, reduce entrance. No open feed leftovers at the apiary.

jul-sommerernte.title: Extract summer flow
jul-sommerernte.guide: Often the main harvest. Leave brood-chamber reserves, log yield. Plan varroa treatment immediately after.

jul-varroa.title: 1st varroa treatment after harvest
jul-varroa.approxDate: late July · right after last harvest
jul-varroa.guide: Treat only after the last honey harvest. Follow label and temperature window. Record date and colonies.

jul-fuetterung.title: Start winter feeding
jul-fuetterung.guide: Estimate stores, fill the feeder. Reduce entrance, feed evenings. Rough guide 15–20 kg – adjust to your method.

aug-fuetterung.title: Finish winter feeding
aug-fuetterung.guide: By mid/late August winter stores should largely be in. Check weight; only small corrections left.

aug-milben.title: Check varroa treatment success
aug-milben.guide: Assess mite drop (e.g. insert 48–72 h). High residual load → plan a follow-up treatment.

aug-raeuberei.title: Prevent robbing (reduce entrances)
aug-raeuberei.guide: Reduce entrance to a few cm. Keep hives tight, no open honey/syrup leftovers. Protect weak colonies especially.

sep-varroa2.title: 2nd varroa treatment (if needed)
sep-varroa2.guide: Retreat if residual counts are high. Mind temperature and brood status. Goal: low-mite winter bees.

sep-staerke.title: Check colony strength for winter
sep-staerke.guide: Bee-packed seams? Young bees, enough stores, healthy look? Don’t leave very weak colonies alone.

sep-vereinigen.title: Unite weak colonies
sep-vereinigen.guide: Better one strong winter colony than two losses. Move frames or use newspaper method. Then keep entrance reduced.

okt-fuetterung-ende.title: Feeding must be finished
okt-fuetterung-ende.guide: Final weight check. Liquid feed should be largely capped. No large open feeds in cold weather.

okt-maeuse.title: Fit mouse guards
okt-maeuse.guide: Mount a suitable guard firmly on the entrance. Ensure bees can still pass.

okt-ruhe.title: Start winter rest
okt-ruhe.guide: No more inspections. Weight the lid, wind-sheltered orientation. Outside checks only.

nov-windel.title: Last varroa check (insert)
nov-windel.guide: Insert for 2–3 days, count mites. Schedule oxalic acid (broodless).

nov-wachs.title: Workshop: render old frames
nov-wachs.guide: Melt old comb, clean and wire frames, prepare foundation. Avoid wax moth.

nov-ausruestung.title: Clean equipment
nov-ausruestung.guide: Clean hives, smoker, suit. Store spare boxes dry. Check treatment shelf life.

dez-oxal.title: Winter treatment (oxalic acid) broodless
dez-oxal.guide: Oxalic works best broodless. Open briefly, trickle seams, close immediately. Label and regulations take priority.

dez-ruhe.title: Absolute quiet at the apiary
dez-ruhe.guide: Clear snow from the entrance. Watch for damage from outside. No curious openings or noisy work at the stand.
